thread:
emma (AE): FYI Contoso POC moving to signature. Procurement sent amended MSA + DPA with two SLA redlines. Need legal/ops path — who signs and what's the fallback? :wave:
raj (SE): Is the DPA our standard template or the customer's? Any major structural changes flagged?
emma (AE): They've changed breach notif timeline (30d -> 90d) and removed our audit rights. Also added a PO payment term referencing 'net90' — procurement flagged.
lisa (Legal): @emma can you drop the doc id and envelope? I'll triage. We typically push back on extending breach timelines and removing audit rights.
emma (AE): DocuSign envelope 0f3a9... Orderform PO-4421 attached by mike. Envelope link: https://docusign.com/envelopes/0f3a9
legal-bot: Document uploaded: "Contoso_MSA_Amended_v3.pdf" by mike (Procurement) at 2025-11-12 09:03
mike (Procurement): We need a pragmatic path: if exec won't accept our redlines, customer wants to sign the orderform only and attach the DPA later. Can we allow orderform-only signing and attach DPA post-sign? Risk? :thinking_face:
lisa (Legal): Orderform-only is risky. If the DPA isn't executed, there are no data transfer safeguards. We can accept an interim OF signature only if we insert a conditional clause on the OF that withholds production provisioning until the DPA is signed. I'll draft language.
raj (SE): From the POC side they want access to hosted env asap. Can we provision limited access (masked data, limited seats) without live customer data until DPA is done?
emma (AE): They agreed to masked data for POC. I'll propose limited seats + no export during onboarding.
lisa (Legal): Draft amendment: "Provisioning of POC access is contingent upon execution of the Data Addendum within 30 days; if not executed access will be disabled." I'll send redline in ~30m.
emma (AE): Thanks — procurement also asked for fallback signature routing: legal sign -> finance -> sales. If exec required, CRO can sign. Can you add that?
mike (Procurement): Finance approved up to $25k. Above that requires CFO/CRO signature. Also confirm billing term: we prefer net30; customer asked net90.
lisa (Legal): We'll keep net30 in contract. Procurement can negotiate payment terms off-contract but legal won't change contract payment obligations to net90. I'll include approval checklist and sign routing.
emma (AE): Plan: route DocuSign to lisa -> mike -> emma -> customer exec. If legal wants to sign first, route to lisa first. Any objections?
lisa (Legal): No objections. If customer pushes for faster turnaround, route to me first so we can lock redlines. :thumbsup:
emma (AE): Got it. I'll update the envelope and ping again when redline uploaded. Closing loop in 45m."
